_doc: PROPS-REUSE-20261113 (Tom, 13 November: «3D-objekter må kunne brukes flere steder»): the real models more than one place may stand up, named once (S47PropCatalogue). A placing file names one by its id: gas_cosmos.json's pieces and a site's dress file with "model": "<id>", an S47Props placement file with "model": "cat:<id>". asset: the /Game object path; bought packs lie under /Game/Licensed (Git-ignored) and Content/Free is not in Git either, so every entry is load-if-present and the place keeps its stand-in without it. size_cm: the mesh's bounds in its own axes (x, y, z), as imported (Tools/cosmosshop/verification.json; ~ marks a measure taken from the source script, not the import). front: the mesh axis the front looks along; the Cosmos shop pieces and the Dale chair look along +Y (S47SaroPeriodProps: the chair faces +Three Z; gas_cosmos.json: the fridge at yaw -90 looks into the shop from the west wall), so on a placement yaw 0 sends the front to town +z, yaw 180 to -z, yaw -90 to +x, yaw 90 to -x. Not read by S47Props as a placement file.
